admission_apply.text: You set a thumb on the gap. The thin pitch stops short, and the break shifts one edge.

native.admission_inspect: The tin is warm at three edges and cold at the fourth, which stops a hair short and holds a thin unfinished pitch.
apply_texts: Nothing new yields. The rim is a closed line your hand cannot finish.
The break circles and does not close. A high thin sound dies at the same missing join.
The flat tin steadies your count. Four corners, one gap. The unfinished pitch thins.
The gap travels. Turning the square only repeats the same edge from a poorer angle.
The same join meets your thumb again, one place on, and still will not close.
You set a thumb on the gap. The thin pitch stops short, and the break shifts one edge.
You try to include the missing side. The square stays flat and will not hold it.
You turn it and meet the same cold face. The count settles: a square, unfinished.
inspect_texts: Corners will not hold still: three, then four. The tin is cold and perfectly flat.
Edges disagree on which face is outer. The tin stays flat; only the count fails.
Still only tin. The missing join has gone around the rim and has not closed.
The break has slid one place along the rim. Same missing length; no longer where it was.
The gap stays one hair short, yet it leans to a side this flat view cannot include.
The tin is warm at three edges and cold at the fourth, which stops a hair short and holds a thin unfinished pitch.
You can bound the square, not the way the break points. It offers no further side.
native.name: Unclosed Square
